In this lesson, you will learn to:

• Build a LEGO® model
• Connect your model to your device
• Program the Motion Sensor to detect motion

Max and Mia want to throw a surprise party for a friend. They do not know when the friend will come to their house.
They need a device to warn them.

They want to build a spy robot. 

Max and Mia need your help!

Make the robot play a sound when it detects motion.

1. Create the program as shown.

2. Explain to each other how the robot works.

Help Max and Mia further (optional): 

1. Record your own sound and make the robot play it.

2. Program the robot to do other things.
<font size="3">Turn on the Smarthub and connect it to your device.</font>
